name: Revscale AI
description:
Revscale AI connects Claude to your franchise growth and customer engagement platform, giving you direct access to lead data, AI agent activity, and knowledge base management without leaving your conversation.

Query and drill into leads captured across lead finder campaigns and email outreach, filtering by status, sentiment, and reply activity. Monitor your AI agents — including lead finder, web pixel, re-engagement, inbound email, and chatbot agents — with normalized activity feeds and checkpoint-level detail to debug performance or understand behavior. Review and edit the exact training context (rules and knowledge documents) each agent uses, and keep your knowledge base current by adding new documents from URLs or updating existing ones. Analyze website visitor journeys with raw or aggregated web pixel traffic data grouped by page, referrer, or day. Built for franchise and multi-location businesses that need AI-driven lead generation, automated engagement, and clear visibility into what their agents are doing and why.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Revscale AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Revscale AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.revscale.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Revscale AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revscale AI provides these MCP tools: add_training_document, ask_knowledge_base, get_agent_activities, get_agent_context, get_enabled_agents, get_lead_details, get_leads, get_webpixel_traffic, update_training_document, update_training_rules, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Revscale AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Revscale AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Revscale AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revscale AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Revscale AI is developed by Revscale AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
